about: Generated by tools/map_layout.mjs from map/world/S6.json; never edit. Metres in the section frame: X east (out of the city in S5), D north, H up. Entities keep their map IDs; figures and trees also carry their slug as id for people.json.

assumptions: East-west and height share S5's scale, 77 px per metre; depth is 51.25 px of v per metre everywhere on the ground. With them the street figures are about 1.3x life, as at the gate (adults 175-243 px, children 104-134 px, sedan bearers 156-182 px).

Things far up the silk are painted smaller than the frame's one scale allows (see questions): positions along the street still come from foot points and base corners, but sizes read at the back of the silk are about 0.55-0.6 of what they would be at the street.
Painted figure size is not a scale. Place by foot point.

datum.about: where the main street crosses the seam with S5 (u 5600): its last centre-line point, exactly S5's road end (scan 5600, 1250). Station -26.51 there, the station of S5.road.main's west end, so stations run on from the gate (more negative going west, into the city).

trees.what: Second low tree of long, thin, leafless shoots rising from below the silk's bottom edge, its shoots crossing in front of the tiled roof east of the signboard.
Low tree or pollard of many long, thin, leafless shoots fanning up from below the silk's bottom edge in front of the south-side roofs; its trunk is cut off by the silk edge.

Large tree with no leaves drawn: fans of long, thin, straight twigs spreading up and out from forked branches (a bare or just-budding tree, perhaps a willow, but the twigs rise rather than hang), growing in front of the south-side houses and cut by the silk's bottom edge; its sprays hide the feet of the sedan bearers.
Only the top of a crown of fine needle-stroke fans shows above the ridge of the big roof north-west of the 正店's upper storey, at the top edge of the silk; a tree behind that roof.

Tall tree with a straight trunk and forked branches carrying wide fans of long, fine needle strokes (pine-like), rising behind the roofs at the west end of the 正店's upper storey; its crown spreads over the roof of the house to its north-west.
Crown of long sweeping willow-like strands at the very top of the silk, above the roof ridges east of the 楊家應症 signboard; its trunk is hidden behind the roofs.
Crown of a third leafless tree with fine upcurving twigs at the lower edge, in front of the inn's middle roofs.
Crown of a second leafless tree with fine upcurving twigs, rising from below the silk's edge in front of the inn's roofs.
Crown of a leafless tree with many fine upcurving twigs (elm-like, or a willow before leafing) rising from below the silk's lower edge in front of the inn's west end.

Huge old willow with a thick trunk leaning a little west, forking at about two-thirds of the way up into a long west limb and several east limbs, with long hanging whips; its crown spreads over the well, the street and the stall's umbrellas from the west edge of the tile to beyond u 2750.
Pine-like (or bamboo) crown of needle clusters beside a carved gable post at the top of the silk.
Pine-like (or bamboo) tree with dense needle clusters in the courtyard at the top of the silk.
Smaller pine-like (or bamboo) crown of needle clusters between the two taller ones in the courtyard at the top of the silk.
Pine-like (or bamboo) tree with dense clusters of short needle strokes, in the walled courtyard at the top of the silk behind the buildings.

S6.veh.sack_cart_5412.name: big two-wheeled cart loaded with sacks
S6.veh.sack_cart_5412.what: Large two-wheeled cart piled high with big round roped sacks, drawn west by a donkey team on long slack traces and pushed from behind; one big spoked wheel shows on the near side.

S6.veh.sedan_4965.name: east sedan chair
S6.veh.sedan_4965.what: Sedan chair with a dark rounded roof whose eave tips turn up, over a tall box seen corner-on: an X-braced rear (west) end and a lattice-windowed south side; no passenger shows. Carried east, slightly north of east, on two long poles by four bearers, two at each end.

S6.veh.sedan_4575.name: west sedan chair (the matchmaker's)
S6.veh.sedan_4575.what: Sedan chair (轿) with a curved roof whose eaves turn up at both ends over a tall box: a lattice window on its south side through which a woman looks out, a decorated panel east of it and an open, ladder-like frame at its west end; carried east on two long poles by two bearers at the front (east) and at least one at the rear (west, beyond u 4400).

S6.veh.taiping_wagon_3600.name: big four-mule wagon (太平车) turning out of the cross street
S6.veh.taiping_wagon_3600.what: Large box-bodied wagon (太平车) with high plank sides and a big spoked wheel, swinging out of the cross street to the south-west: its front end is at the lower left, where the shafts run down to the team of four mules, its rear (with a rack of rails and a hanging rope) at the upper right. A man sits on the front of the bed, a burly carter walks between the shafts, and another walks beside it past the wheel.

S6.veh.hidden_wagon_3400.name: second wagon, hidden behind the corner shed
S6.veh.hidden_wagon_3400.what: A second wagon whose body is entirely hidden behind the corner shed's dark mat roof; only its four-mule team, its driver and the traces running back west under the roof's tip are painted. It heads east, toward the crossroads.

S6.veh.barrow_casks_3300.name: loaded 串车 barrow at the incense shop's corner
S6.veh.barrow_casks_3300.what: 串车-type barrow with one big spoked wheel, loaded with large round dark bundles (or casks: round ends show) lashed with ropes; a raised front rack with hooks at its east end. Its pusher, standing between the handles at its west end, is west of u 3200.

S6.veh.barrow_top_3340.name: wheelbarrow at the top of the silk
S6.veh.barrow_top_3340.what: Small wheelbarrow (串车 type) with one spoked wheel under its front half and a slatted bed; its pointed front end faces west (u 3271) and two handles with a pair of rear legs stand at the east end, where a man leans over it. No load is visible on the bed.

S6.veh.wine_cart_3090.name: donkey cart with two wine casks
S6.veh.wine_cart_3090.what: Big cart carrying two large lidded wine casks side by side (each with a knob on its lid) and a wicker basket hung at its rear, on a heavy frame with a big spoked wheel near the front; drawn east by a pair of donkeys in harness, the driver sitting at the front with a long whip.

S6.veh.barrow_casks_3300.why: painted beside the lead mules of the big wagon's team; at real size the team (two ranks of two mules ahead of the wagon's shafts) reaches over its spot, so the barrow and the man pushing it (people.json nudge) stand 1.8 m south-east, at the mouth of the cross street

S6.prop.table_upper_5497.why: the 正店's upper storey ends at the wine depot's west wall (X -47.1; painted, its east room runs on over the depot, but the gate's builder makes the depot 4 m deep): the east room's table and what is on it shift 0.9 m west with its end wall

S6.tree.pine_4430.why: its estimated base (hidden behind the roofs) falls inside the corner shop at the crossroads; moved 1.9 m along its painted receding line (towards the viewer) so its trunk stands in the yard between the corner shop and the 正店's west end, behind the butcher's shop, rising behind the roofs as painted

S6.ani.mule_lower_3_3498.why: the wagon's team (four mules painted overlapping, ~1 m ahead of the wagon) set out at real size: the rear pair (shaft mule, mule 3) on the wagon's axis just ahead of its shafts, the lead pair 2.4 m further on turning 10 deg south as the team swings onto the main street (painted heading 195 would put their heads in the incense shop's scaffold)
